_comment: Paths and registry values that change on their own, even inside a freshly booted
Windows Sandbox, and therefore cannot be treated as installer footprint.
Keep this list SHORT and justify every entry. Every pattern here is a place a real
leak could hide, so a lazy broad pattern silently weakens A3 (reversibility).
Patterns are .NET regex, matched case-insensitively against the full path.

filePatterns.why: Per-user registry hive file, rewritten constantly by explorer
Notification database, written by the shell
NGen/CLR usage traces, written whenever any .NET process runs
PowerShell writes this on every single launch, including ours
Regenerated whenever a PowerShell module is imported

envVarPatterns.why: Session-scoped or appended to by any installed module
